confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Annecy's July tourist prices; not checked against live menus, listings or rates, and no web sources were used for city prices. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain given wide peak-season swings. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer (cocktail about twice beer, wine modestly above) because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX figure is from search summaries of the RBA page, not a direct page read, and was not used to set the USD anchors.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Regional basis: Savoie and Haute-Savoie lakeside and Alpine tourist towns, such as Aix-les-Bains and Chamonix, adjusted upward for July peak demand. Not benchmarked against Paris or Geneva.
